images.prompt: Create ONE standalone landscape illustration 1536x1024, aspect 3:2, edge-to-edge, no panels, no borders, no labels, no typography, no readable text anywhere. Every major contour must align with the FIRST reference; the existing geometry is the authority. Do not change the composition.
